method: Read-only inspection of the server access/error logs, retaining only the public package path, response timestamp, status and byte count. No requester identity, IP, user agent or raw log was retained.
scope: The server recorded an incomplete HTTP response before the native download returned download-failed. This supports a transfer failure, but does not identify which network peer closed the connection or recover the underlying exception swallowed by the baseline updater. It is not an installation or restart success.
